title: Marco Leal re-interviews Carlos about 25 years later

tellings.quote: "Wow, your account is exactly the same as the one you gave 25 years ago. Identical. Not a single detail has changed."

plain: Around 2021 in São Paulo, Brazil, a man named Marco Leal interviewed the surgeon Carlos de Souza again, about 25 years after first hearing his story, and found it had not changed at all. De Souza, who says his hospital once operated on an alien, recalls Leal telling him: "Your account is exactly the same as the one you gave 25 years ago. Identical. Not a single detail has changed." De Souza tells it in a 2026 interview as a sign that his memory has stayed steady.
